Summary: Bond minimum increase for specialty trades
Detail: Effective 01/01/2025 the minimum surety bond for Electrical Plumbing and HVAC specialty contractors is increased from $12000 to $20000. General and other specialty contractors remain at $12000 minimum.
Action_Required: Verify bond amounts for all new specialty trade applications meet updated threshold

Detail: For any applicant whose prior license was suspended revoked or marked OUT OF BUSINESS the examiner must independently verify insurance directly with the carrier. Self-reported insurance data on the application is insufficient for these applicants.
Action_Required: Cross-reference insurance records and contact carrier if prior license had adverse status

Detail: Any applicant found to have performed contracting work in Washington without a valid license within the 12 months preceding the application date is subject to a mandatory 6-month application hold from the date of the unlicensed activity finding. The hold may be waived only by the Program Manager upon written petition demonstrating remediation.
Action_Required: Check violations database and field reports for unlicensed activity within 12 months of application date

Detail: Specialty trade applicants (Electrical Plumbing HVAC) claiming experience must provide verifiable employer references or journeyman certification from a recognized jurisdiction. Self-attested experience without third-party verification is no longer accepted.
Action_Required: Flag applications relying solely on self-reported experience years without supporting documentation
